'''Fozec''' was one of the many [[Human/Legends|Human]] guards kept around [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Unlike the others, Fozec was a spy planted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], assigned to keep tabs on Jabba's illicit activities for the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. He secretly hoped to defect from the ISB in order to pursue more lucrative opportunities in the galactic underworld.

==Biography==
[[File:LookJabba-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|200px|Fozec prepares to escort Han Solo to the dungeons]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Fozec was present in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] when the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] in an attempt to rescue the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Those events led to Jabba sentencing Solo and a couple of the others to [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], and Fozec was among Jabba's associates who accompanied the Hutt on his [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]], the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], in order to witness the executions. However, the captives [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fought back]] against Jabba's forces and destroyed the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]].

Fozec wore elements of [[Tantel armor/Legends|Tantel armor]].
